problem: The patched Execution Plane regression runs a mixed native suite only after candidate patches are applied. Existing failures in the pinned N.E.K.O baseline can therefore be falsely attributed to the candidate, while genuine new failures must still fail closed.

selected.mechanism: existing GitHub Actions job + pytest built-in JUnit XML + Python stdlib XML parser
selected.policy: run the exact regression selection once on clean pinned c3 and once after the candidate patches; fail only when patched failures are not a subset of baseline failures
selected.reason: Adds no test framework, service or persistent store; preserves strict incremental regression detection.

considered.reason: cannot distinguish candidate regressions from baseline red tests
built-in pytest output; already available in native test runtime

invariants: clean and patched runs use the exact same explicit test selection
patched-only failing testcase identities fail the job
baseline failures are reported but not falsely attributed to the candidate
candidate-specific effect-state/receipt/ZMQ verifiers remain mandatory independent gates
no native test is edited or weakened to accommodate the candidate
